대한민국 민법
The civil law of South Korea governing inheritance, divorce, and related daily legal matters.

가정법원
The family court responsible for legal declarations and rulings regarding inheritance, divorce, and child custody.

상속포기
A legal procedure where an heir renounces their inheritance rights, including debts, within three months of knowing about the inheritance opening.

한정승인
A conditional acceptance of inheritance where an heir agrees to pay the deceased's debts only within the limit of the inherited property.

재산분할청구권
The right of a spouse to claim a division of jointly formed property upon divorce, which expires two years after the divorce date.

면접교섭권
The right of the non-custodial parent to meet and communicate with their child after a divorce.

양육비
The financial maintenance expenses that the non-custodial parent has the obligation to pay to the custodial parent for child-rearing.

피상속인
The deceased person whose property and inheritance are passed down under civil law.

상속인
The person who inherits the property, assets, and debts of a deceased individual according to the law.

제1순위 상속인
The primary heirs consisting of descendants and the spouse of the deceased.

제2순위 상속인
The secondary heirs consisting of ascendants and the spouse of the deceased.

배우자
The husband or wife of the deceased or divorcing party who holds specific inheritance shares and property division rights.

직계비속
Direct descendants such as children and grandchildren of the deceased.

직계존속
Direct ascendants such as parents and grandparents of the deceased.

협의이혼
A divorce completed through mutual agreement between spouses.

재판상 이혼
A divorce finalized through judicial court proceedings.

친권자
The parent designated to hold parental authority over minor children after a divorce.

양육자
The parent designated to raise and care for minor children after a divorce.

비양육친
The parent who does not have custody of the minor child after a divorce.
